analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong growth in Q1 FY27, driven by the expansion of its offline branch network and core business. The company has successfully launched its digital platform, AkikoPay, on both Android and iOS, which is expected to complement its core credit and loan distribution business. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR325-350 crores and expressed confidence in achieving a 9% to 11% PAT margin. The company has no plans for fundraising in the next 6 to 12 months as internal accruals and bank support remain strong. Akiko Global Services Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, recording revenue from operations of ₹6,812.2 lacs and PAT of ₹701.6 lacs.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to between INR325 crores and INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects its CAGR to remain at 70% to 100% year-on-year for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: The company expects its PAT margin to increase to 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
guidance.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach around INR1,000 crores in disbursements by the end of December.
guidance.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

guidance.claim: Management stated that it remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum target of 70% to 100% revenue growth for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company expects profit margins to remain at similar levels of profitability in FY27.
guidance.quote: And profit margins will also remain with similar profitability.

guidance.claim: The company has a long-term vision to achieve INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: The company expects AkikoPay to generate around INR 50 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: The company's revenue outlook for 2027 is above INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects to close the first quarter with revenue between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: This quarter I'll close around INR65 crores to INR70 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has strong bank partnerships and a healthy sourcing pipeline, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: AkikoPay is receiving a daily average of 200 to 300 credit leads for loans and credit cards.
demand_outlook.quote: On AkikoPay, credit leads coming in such as for loans and credit cards, if I look at the daily average, we are getting 200 to 300 leads.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing INR2 lakh to INR3 lakh deposited into its wallet daily and expects this to reach more than INR10 lakh or INR20 lakh from next month.
demand_outlook.quote: And we are seeing INR2 lakh to INR3 lakh deposited into our wallet every day, which I am expecting to reach more than INR10 lakh or INR20 lakh from next month onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently the fastest-growing loan products for the company.
The company is successfully disbursing over 16,000 credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
demand_outlook.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has built partnerships with over 40 banks and NBFCs, including 20 to 25 new partnerships built during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: And we have built partnerships with 40+ banks and NBFCs, in which 20 to 25 new partnerships have been built this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Almost 70% of the company's sourcing is now happening digitally.
demand_outlook.quote: The most important thing is that almost 70% of sourcing is now happening digitally, which is improving productivity and making customer acquisition costs better, and targeting capabilities are also becoming stronger.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is acquiring around 60% of its loan business digitally.
demand_outlook.quote: Digitally, we are acquiring around 60% of the business.

demand_outlook.claim: Around 40% of the company's business comes from channel partners such as builders, CAs, and doctors.
demand_outlook.quote: 40% business comes from our channel partners like builders, CAs, doctors and other co-channel partners.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open new branches in Indore and Kerala over the next 2-3 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a total plan for 25 branches.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: All of the company's branches are on rent or lease, and none are owned.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is progressing with the launch of the iOS version of AkikoPay as planned to provide a comprehensive experience.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its company-owned branch presence across multiple cities.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has increased its branch count from three or four in the last quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around INR 1 crore in total so far on building technology for AkikoPay.
capex_expansion.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it.

margins_costs.claim: The company's profit faced slight stress in the previous quarter due to opening several branches across multiple cities.
margins_costs.quote: As I mentioned last time, our profit faced slight stress last quarter because we opened several branches across multiple cities.

margins_costs.claim: The company will not incur any unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: We will not incur any unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay.

margins_costs.claim: The company plans to acquire customers at a negligible cost using only its employees and existing database.
margins_costs.quote: We will acquire customers at a negligible cost using only our employees and existing database.

margins_costs.claim: Akiko Global delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability across its credit card sourcing and lending divisions.
margins_costs.quote: The Company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability, supported by sustained momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending businesses, reflecting the resilience of its diversified business model.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay utilizes a targeted cashback rate of around 1% to drive user activation and transaction frequency.
margins_costs.quote: Targeted cashback (~1%) driving user acquisition, activation, and transaction frequency

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay achieves approximately 40% lower customer acquisition cost compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: The lending portfolio delivers a 3-4% blended yield on disbursals.
Margin pressure in Q4 was due to planned investments in branch expansion.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: The company spent money on technology infrastructure for the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.
margins_costs.quote: Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical situations around the Iran region caused temporary margin pressure in Dubai operations.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: The company's workforce consists of 486 employees and 430 channel partners acting as commission agents in the field.
margins_costs.quote: The number I have given you is around 486 our employees and rest 430 are our channel partners in field who are commission agents.

margins_costs.claim: The company's customer acquisition cost is around INR 10 to INR 15.
margins_costs.quote: Where Paytm, PhonePe or CRED spends around INR250 to acquire a customer, there our cost comes to INR10 to INR15.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's offline business, core business, and distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.
orders_capacity.quote: our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's team includes 16 people on tech, around 700 on sales, and around 50 on the backend.
orders_capacity.quote: Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people. And the rest are our management staff.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's unsecured loan disbursements have an average payout of 3.10%.
orders_capacity.quote: First of all, within INR450 crores, all of this is unsecured. In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals reached over ₹450 crore, and monthly credit card sourcing reached 17,000–18,000 cards in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: AkikoPay recorded 9,000 monthly active users and 1,000 daily active users.
orders_capacity.quote: MAU (Monthly Active User): 9K | DAU (Daily Active User): 1K, indicating consistent early-stage platform activity

orders_capacity.claim: AkikoPay achieved over 30,000 Android app downloads.
orders_capacity.quote: 30K+ Android app downloads reflecting strong initial adoption

orders_capacity.claim: The company has reached a monthly disbursement run rate of over INR 400 crores, representing an annual book of INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's unsecured book stands at INR 320 crores, while the secured book is INR 80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: INR320 crores unsecured, INR80 crores secured.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has absolutely no plans for fundraising at the moment.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not see any need for fundraising for the next 6 months to a year due to strong bank support and aligned CC limits.
capital_allocation.quote: Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days have decreased from 133 days to 110 days.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects receivable days to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to focus more on unsecured business to avoid pressure on operating cash flows from delayed commissions on secured loans.
capital_allocation.quote: So we have decided that if we can grow business more from unsecured without any fund-raise, we have more potential, then this year we will go towards unsecured business rather than a secured business.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's total revenue from its Dubai business was limited to INR1.25 crores for the quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced compliance-related issues on the App Store because AkikoPay is a financial app.
risks_headwinds.quote: There were some compliance-related issues on the App Store -- since it's a financial app, compliance involves certain requirements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations around the Iran region caused temporary margin pressure in Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

risks_headwinds.claim: Delayed disbursement times of two to three months for housing loans and mortgages increase receivable days and pressure operating cash flows.
risks_headwinds.quote: And the problem in that is that our receivable days increase because if anyone takes a housing loan, takes a mortgage, then the disbursement time becomes two to three months.

risks_headwinds.claim: AkikoPay's integration on Apple was delayed due to compliance issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: AkikoPay has not been integrated in Apple yet because there were some compliance issues.

management_commitments.claim: The company is comfortable achieving INR325 crores to INR350 crores in revenue for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to compete with major market leaders over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: As for what we planned for AkikoPay, over the next 2 years, I will compete with the major leaders in the market.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve ₹300–325 crore in revenue for FY27 while sustaining healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to roll out the comprehensive iOS version of AkikoPay in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects around INR 50 crores in revenue from AkikoPay in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching an unsecured book of INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
